crossRefs.note: But on the next day they left the horsemen to go with him, and returned to the barracks.

translations.web: But on the next day they left the horsemen to go with him, and returned to the barracks.
translations.bsb: The next day they returned to the barracks and let the horsemen go on with him.
translations.kjv: On the morrow they left the horsemen to go with him, and returned to the castle:
translations.asv: But on the morrow they left the horsemen to go with him, and returned to the castle:
